evidence.title: WnW: Waxing-and-Waning KV Cache for Long-Form Speech LLMs

summary: A new technique called Waxing-and-Waning KV Cache aims to improve efficiency in long-form speech large language models by dynamically managing key-value memory. This approach could enhance performance and reduce computational overhead for extended audio processing.
title: Waxing-and-Waning KV Cache Introduced for Long-Form Speech LLMs
